entries.reason: Build-time-only dependency of Sentry's Next.js tooling; await an SDK-compatible Rollup update instead of overriding its peer graph.

Sharp 0.35 prebuilt binaries require x86-64-v2 but the current Coolify host is v1. The upstream workaround is active: GIF, TIFF and VIPS loaders are blocked globally, and transformed uploads reject blocked MIME types while the host upgrade or source build is prepared. Host upgrade plan and the sharp 0.35 rollout are tracked in docs/SHARP_HOST_UPGRADE.md.

Same host constraint as GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj: the fix is sharp >=0.35.4 and 0.35.x prebuilt binaries need x86-64-v2 while the Coolify host is v1 — a previous attempt deployed green and failed every upload at runtime. Accepted on the same expiry so both lapse with the host upgrade tracked in docs/SHARP_HOST_UPGRADE.md.

Time-boxed exception, owner devops. librsvg memory bug bundled with sharp <0.35.5; the fix (0.35.5) needs x86-64-v2 and the Coolify host is v1 (docs/SHARP_HOST_UPGRADE.md), and no 0.34.x patch exists. Not reachable here: (1) the API applies the upstream workaround, blocking VipsForeignLoadSvg in apps/api/src/common/image/sharp-safety.ts, pinned by a real-sharp test in strip-image-metadata.spec.ts; SVG is also not an accepted upload type. (2) Next.js 15.5 image optimisation (web, admin; dangerouslyAllowSVG is on) picks the decoder by sniffing the upstream bytes and returns SVG, BMP and the other bypass types untouched; only JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, TIFF and JP2 reach sharp, and libvips picks a non-SVG loader for those signatures (checked against sharp 0.34.5). remotePatterns do not limit this: s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com without a pathname admits any path-style bucket. (3) Defence in depth: the advisory names RCE only on glibc Linux and every image is node:20-alpine (musl); the use-after-free itself still exists on musl. Resolve by the host upgrade or a source build of sharp 0.35.5 before expiry; do not extend without re-review.

No patched zod 3 release exists (3.25.76 is the latest 3.x; the fix is zod >=4.6.6, a major upgrade of every form schema). Not reachable with untrusted input on a server: the API uses zod only in config/env.validation.ts (its own environment); request bodies go through class-validator DTOs. Web and admin run zod in the browser on the user's own form input. zod 4 (openai) is overridden to ^4.6.6. Resolve by the zod 4 migration before expiry; do not extend without re-review.
